title: Werewolf GUI
description:
Shows the current shapeshifting form of Werewolf (and other shifter) characters right on the canvas.

  • Form badge under the token — a small plate below the token displays the active form icon (Homid / Glabro / Crinos / Hispo / Lupus).
  • Form bar — a small, movable panel with one-click form switching, so players do not have to open the character sheet. Its position is remembered per user.
  • Works with the legacy Werewolf / Changing Breed sheets and with the new PC Actor sheet (Shapeshifting Form Trait items).
  • Keeps the base actor and its unlinked tokens in sync, so a form change updates the sheet, the token and every scene.
  • Icons are taken from the World of Darkness system assets — no artwork is duplicated by this module.

Requires the World of Darkness 20th edition system.
